queries.topic: Susceptor-assisted induction heating of non-conductive/ceramic charges (graphite & refractory-metal susceptors, 1700-2500 C)
queries.query: For induction heating systems that use susceptors to heat electrically non-conductive or poorly coupling charges (e.g., ceramics such as yttria-stabilized zirconia), review the literature on graphite and refractory-metal (e.g., tantalum) susceptor design and use: RF coupling efficiency, susceptor geometry and placement, heat transfer to the charge by conduction/radiation, achievable temperatures and operating limits at 1700-2500 C, and susceptor vapor deposition / contamination of the charge. Cite high-quality sources with bibtex.

queries.topic: Grain growth in yttria-stabilized zirconia (YSZ): kinetics, temperature-time regimes, atmosphere effects
queries.query: Review the literature on grain growth in yttria-stabilized zirconia (YSZ): kinetics (growth exponents, activation energies), temperature-time regimes for producing large-grained (tens of microns) equiaxed microstructures at 1700-2500 C, and the effects of atmosphere (vacuum, argon, reducing conditions) and contamination (carbon, refractory metals) on grain growth, darkening/reduction, and specimen integrity. Cite high-quality sources with bibtex.

queries.topic: High-temperature chemical compatibility of refractory materials (Ta, graphite, BN, MgO, alumina, zirconia)
queries.query: Review high-temperature (1700-2500 C) chemical compatibility among refractory materials used as crucibles and susceptors: tantalum, graphite/carbon, boron nitride, magnesia (MgO), alumina, and zirconia. Include carburization of tantalum (TaC formation), alumina-carbon reactions and eutectics near 1800 C, carbothermal reduction/consumption of zirconia by carbon, Ta-BN and Ta-MgO interface degradation, interdiffusion and vapor transport (Ta deposition on ceramic specimens), and oxygen gettering by tantalum. Cite high-quality sources with bibtex.

queries.topic: Low-cost/open-source laboratory furnace instrumentation and closed-loop pyrometer/PID control retrofits
queries.query: Review literature on low-cost, open-source, or custom-built laboratory high-temperature furnaces and instrument retrofits/modernizations: computer/DAQ-based (e.g., LabVIEW) analog power control of induction or resistance furnaces, closed-loop PID temperature control using non-contact (pyrometer) feedback, vacuum or controlled-atmosphere chamber integration, and open-source-hardware approaches to scientific furnace construction, validation, and publication. Cite high-quality sources with bibtex.

queries.topic: Grain-boundary thermal grooving (Mullins theory) and characterization of as-annealed surfaces
queries.query: Review literature on grain-boundary thermal grooving in annealed metals (especially nickel) and its use for microstructure characterization: Mullins grooving theory and groove growth kinetics, groove dihedral-angle measurement of grain-boundary to surface energy ratios, thermal grooving as a way to reveal grain boundaries without metallographic preparation (etching/polishing), and the quality of EBSD/Kikuchi patterns obtainable from as-annealed (unprepared) surfaces. Cite high-quality sources with bibtex.
